# DSH Studio v0.9.19

## 新增

- 终端支持单窗口、左右分屏、上下分屏和四宫格。布局按稳定标签分组，切换时保留进程和输出；重启仅恢复布局，不自动启动 Shell。
- Git 工作树新增只读变更审阅，区分已暂存/未暂存差异，显示未跟踪路径、变更数量和超大差异提示。支持刷新、键盘操作与原生失败后的重试。
- 长会话每段最多渲染 120 条消息，提供最早、上一段、下一段和最新消息导航；搜索直接定位命中所在段，分页不减少导出内容。

## 变更与安全

- 工作树审阅仅接受当前仓库登记的根目录；禁用外部 diff、文本转换和文件系统监控钩子，限制子进程输出与执行时间。不增加暂存、丢弃、合并或删除操作。
- 将七类非敏感界面偏好保存到有界、原子写入的原生存储。未知键、异常值和损坏存储不会被直接覆盖；窗口刷新保留本次运行的新选择，整进程重启重新恢复原生快照。
- 达到会话读取大小上限时，列表、阅读页、用量提示和三种导出格式明确说明“部分记录”。原始 Harness 日志不修改，不把受限前缀冒充完整记录。
- 延续精确版本、插件兼容性与签名更新保护，不自动豁免不兼容插件。
- 发布流程先上传到私有草稿，等全部平台打包检查及完整产物/校验和验证通过后才公开；已发布版本不再允许同版本重建覆盖。
- 更新清单必须与本次发布的版本、四个基础平台、实际下载资产及其签名文件逐项对应，拒绝旧版本地址、遗漏平台和签名错配。

## 修复与打磨

- 修复 Full 首次安装因缺少运行合同标记和目录选择器适配而被拒绝的问题。离线恢复在暂存目录复用在线安装的桌面适配，生成兼容包内 Node 的启动器及精确版本标记，验证后才替换现有环境。
- 修复 Windows 单文件便携版缺少页面资源的问题，改为完整 ZIP；解压后保留 EXE 旁的 `dist/` 文件夹，发布前重新解压并校验全部资源。
- 修复 Full/Offline 安装包缺少页面资源、内置运行环境目录与原生查找路径不一致的问题。完整包现在同时携带正确位置的 `dist/` 和 `offline/`，并验证精确目录，避免二进制可执行却无法打开界面。
- Full 升级清理旧版专属离线资源目录，并在 Windows 流水线分别验证从上一版 Lite、Full 升级及卸载，检查旧档案残留。
- 修复分类或版本列表过长时菜单溢出窗口的问题：菜单最多 360 像素高，支持内部滚动；键盘切换自动显示选中项，长名称截断显示。真实 553 项分类菜单及六个选择框通过键盘验收。
- 环境检查返回的旧快照不再覆盖刚收到的 Harness 运行状态、日志或清空操作，避免实际已启动但界面显示未运行。
- 双语 README 改用当前 Windows 桌面实际截图，本机路径和局域网地址脱敏，远程访问保持关闭。
- 安装包验证逐文件比对生产构建的页面、懒加载脚本和字体；缺失、旧文件残留或内容不一致都会阻止通过。本机新 MSI 的 33 个前端文件已通过实际解包校验。
- 忽略过期的插件详情、配置清单和会话列表响应，避免慢请求覆盖重新选择、重命名或归档结果；归档操作串行执行并显示忙碌状态。
- 自动插件搜索/刷新失败使用页内提示，主动操作失败仍明确报告；详情加载失败可原地重试。
- 终端退出后保留输出，不再向已结束进程发送输入或尺寸变化；忽略结束后到达的异步 IPC 失败。
- 提升双主题次要文字和状态色对比度，改善高对比度滚动条与搜索高亮，移除会话用量标签、时间戳的额外淡化。
- 修复工作树审阅刷新时的键盘焦点丢失及弹窗遮罩范围，未跟踪文件计入未提交状态，选中工作树使用“当前”标记。
- 对异常巨大的 Token 总量使用饱和累加，防止溢出崩溃或回绕；启动时原子更新 Studio 自有界面集成，覆盖升级不必为新样式重装 Harness。
- 修正安装包大小与进程生命周期说明：轻量版和完整离线版大小不同；隐藏到托盘保留终端，退出应用结束子进程。

## 安装

- 支持覆盖升级和签名的应用内更新。Full / Offline 内置经过校验的固定运行环境；Lite 按需安装。已有配置、插件与会话保留。
- Windows 便携版改为完整 ZIP，其余 Windows、Linux、macOS 安装格式沿用现有发布矩阵。便携版免安装，但运行数据仍使用正常应用数据目录。更新包签名不等于操作系统发布者签名，生成包渠道清单也不代表外部软件仓库已收录。
- 继续包含此前的 `desktop_file_offer` ACL、无效 Profile YAML 修复与 Windows 终端关闭修复，无需删除个人配置。

## 验证

- 本地 421 项前端测试、448 项常规 Rust 测试、99 项打包合同测试及 4,716 组 npm 版本范围对照通过；常规 Rust 运行跳过 7 项条件测试，另行执行实际 Full 档案恢复和真实联网检查。配置的前端核心逻辑范围语句覆盖率为 97.32%、分支覆盖率为 93.75%；不代表全部界面代码覆盖率。
- 生产构建、严格 Clippy、Lint、公开合同、双语文档和无障碍静态检查通过。原生覆盖率门禁的 19 个指定文件均达到至少 80% 行覆盖率，不将网络安装编排等未纳入部分计作达标。
- 真实桌面检查覆盖五个 PTY 的分屏/输出/异常退出、工作树暂存与未暂存审阅、Git 临时不可用后的恢复重试、偏好刷新与重启、4,000 条会话分页/末条搜索/完整导出和超大日志的三种导出警告。
- 三轮真实启停与环境重查验证界面和监管状态一致；多窗口实测确认副窗口共享 Harness，关闭副窗口不停止主窗口的服务。键盘验收包含六个选择框和命令面板。
- 当前界面完成 90 分钟 Windows WebView 长测（18:59:49–20:29:49 UTC），178 轮页面/详情/焦点检查未捕获渲染异常，Harness 保持同一就绪进程。随后 900×620 下六个选择框、557 项分类、Enter 提交和选中标记检查通过；后续离线安装修复另行定向验收，不计入这段长测。
- 本机新 Full MSI 实际解包、原生初始化及 33 项页面资源 HTTP 校验通过；使用包内 Node 22.19.0 启动包内 Harness 0.1.7-rc.2，通过认证页面、应用模块与宿主合同检查。这项离线档案启动检查已加入各平台 Full 打包门禁。
- 新便携 ZIP 解压后的 0.9.19 程序通过实际原生初始化，33 项页面资源的 HTTP 返回内容逐项匹配。
- 修复后在隔离 QA WebView 中通过真实命令，从 Full 内置档案安装 Node 和 Harness 并成功启动。Full 打包门禁同时验证原生安装、损坏档案拒绝后保留旧环境、重装，以及使用原生恢复出的启动器完成认证 Profile 启动，不再由测试脚本补造启动器。
- 单独执行 Node 官方下载/校验/解包与两个真实插件源检查；其中一个目录源首次读取超时，重试通过，不把联网成功视为外部服务永不失败的保证。
- 测试证据区分确定性模拟、原生命令、真实界面和持续运行；不将其中任何一项宣称为所有功能在所有环境中绝无缺陷。macOS 真机、Narrator、付费模型服务及外部 SSH 凭据流程不在本地 Windows 验收范围内。

<!-- dsh-notes:en -->
# DSH Studio v0.9.19

## New features

- Add single, side-by-side, stacked and four-pane terminal layouts with stable groups and retained processes/transcripts. Restoring a layout never launches a shell.
- Add bounded read-only Git worktree review, separate staged/unstaged diffs, untracked paths and native failure/retry handling.
- Render long sessions in segments of up to 120 messages with first/previous/next/latest navigation and direct search-hit positioning. Pagination does not truncate exports.

## Changes and security

- Restrict review to registered roots; disable external diff/text conversion/filesystem-monitor hooks and bound Git output/time. No staging, destructive merge or deletion actions are added.
- Persist seven allowlisted presentation preferences through bounded atomic native storage; preserve damaged files and newer same-process choices during reload.
- Mark size-limited session logs as partial throughout reading, search/usage notices and Markdown/HTML/JSON exports, without changing original logs. Keep plugin compatibility and signed-update safeguards intact.
- Keep uploads in a private draft until all platform checks and the complete artifact/checksum gate pass. Reject same-version rebuilds of already public releases.
- Bind updater entries to the release version, all four base platforms, actual download assets and their signature files; reject stale URLs, missing platforms and mismatched signatures.

## Fixes and polish

- Fix first-time Full installation rejected for a missing runtime marker and directory-picker adapter. Qualify the staged closure, write the bundled-Node-compatible launcher and exact version marker, then verify before replacing the live runtime.
- Replace the incomplete Windows single-file portable download with a ZIP containing its required `dist/` resources. Re-extract and verify the whole frontend before upload.
- Fix Full/Offline bundles missing shell resources and placing the offline runtime outside its native lookup path. Bundle both `dist/` and `offline/` at their required locations and verify the exact manifest directory.
- Clean the legacy owned offline directory on Full upgrades; Windows acceptance covers both prior Lite and Full installers plus uninstall residue.
- Bound long category/version menus to a scrollable 360-pixel surface, keep keyboard selections visible and truncate long labels. Real keyboard acceptance covered a 553-category menu and six selectors.
- Preserve live supervisor status/log events and explicit log clearing over older environment-check snapshots. Refresh bilingual README screenshots from the actual isolated desktop with local path/LAN labels blurred.
- Compare all packaged frontend bytes, including lazy chunks and fonts, against the production build during extraction and upgrade checks. The local candidate MSI passed verification of all 33 frontend files.
- Drop obsolete plugin/profile/session responses, serialize archive writes, keep automatic catalog errors inline and add detail retry.
- Stop input/resize IPC after terminal exit while retaining output. Correct worktree modal focus/backdrop, dirty-state and current-worktree labels.
- Improve both palettes, contrast-mode scrollbars and session search outlines. Safely refresh Studio-owned runtime client assets during in-place upgrades.
- Saturate malformed extreme token totals and correct installer-size and tray-versus-quit documentation.

## Installation

- Upgrade in place or use the signed updater. Full / Offline bundles the verified runtime; Lite provisions it when needed. Existing profiles, plugins and sessions remain intact.
- Windows portable downloads now use a complete ZIP; other Windows/Linux/macOS installer formats remain. Extract everything and keep `dist/` beside the executable. Portable is installation-free but still uses normal application-data storage. Updater signatures are distinct from OS publisher signatures or admission to external package repositories.

## Verification

- 421 frontend tests, 448 ordinary Rust tests, 99 packaging tests and 4,716 npm range comparisons passed locally; the ordinary Rust run skips seven conditional tests, with real Full archive restoration and live checks run separately. The configured frontend core subset reached 97.32% statements and 93.75% branches, not whole-UI coverage.
- Production build, strict Clippy, lint, public contracts, bilingual docs and static accessibility checks passed. All 19 selected native coverage files reached at least 80% lines; this does not include every native module.
- Actual desktop checks cover five PTYs, worktree diffs and genuine missing-Git retry, preference reload/restart, a 4,000-message transcript including its final search hit/export, and oversized-log warnings in all export formats.
- Three actual start/stop/re-check rounds agreed with supervisor state. A secondary native window shared Harness and closed without stopping it. Keyboard acceptance exercised six selectors and the command palette.
- The current UI completed a 90-minute Windows WebView soak (18:59:49–20:29:49 UTC): 178 cycles, no captured renderer exception and the same ready Harness process. A subsequent 900×620 check covered six selectors, 557 categories, Enter commit and selected-state display. The later offline-install fix received separate targeted acceptance, not credit for this earlier soak.
- The rebuilt Full MSI passed extraction, real native initialization and HTTP byte checks for 33 frontend resources. Its own Node 22.19.0 booted its packaged Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 through authenticated application/module/host checks; this now gates Full packages on each platform.
- The extracted 0.9.19 portable ZIP also passed real native initialization and HTTP byte checks for all 33 frontend resources.
- Actual native commands in an isolated QA WebView installed bundled Node and Harness and started the service after the fix. Full packaging now checks native restore, preservation after a rejected corrupt archive, reinstall, and authenticated boot using the native-generated launcher instead of synthesizing one in the test.
- Live Node download/checksum/extraction and both reviewed catalogs were checked separately. One catalog timed out initially and passed on retry; external availability is not guaranteed.
- Mocked logic, native commands, actual UI and soak evidence are kept distinct. No zero-defect claim is made; physical macOS, Narrator, paid providers and external SSH credentials are outside local Windows acceptance.

<!-- dsh-notes:end -->
